name: adrian-utils
summary: Generic Python utilities — KEV environment manager, XDG directories, persistent dedup filter, structured logger (lines and spans as one JSON or human event stream, shared with go-utils and ts-utils), number/percentage/currency formatting, terminal presentation (ANSI-aware tables, semantic palette, live regions with spinners and progress, ported from ts-utils), TTS text normalization (say). Python 3.12+.
